name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: US strike on Qeshm 7 Nov; talks via Qatar
summary: US strikes Iranian air defences on Qeshm Island on 7 Nov as Iran weighs Qatari proposals for a bridge deal
state: The US carried out limited strikes on Iranian air defences on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz overnight into 7 Nov, which President Trump called minor; the Revolutionary Guards said they downed a US drone over Qeshm on 6 Nov (Euronews). Regional officials said Iran is reviewing a Qatari proposal that would lift the US port blockade and reopen Hormuz, and Qatar denied that talks had collapsed (Arab News, citing Reuters). Active strikes between states continue.
for_you: Travellers to the Gulf should follow FCDO travel advice, which is being updated as the conflict develops.
rubric_hit: Active US strikes on Iran (7 Nov) = Alert

sources.title: Euronews — US launches new targeted strikes on Iran as Trump claims progress in talks
Arab News (Reuters) — US military carries out new targeted strike on Iran as Tehran weighs mediator's proposals

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
